facts.summary: Serious hypotony adverse reaction reported; study unmasked · Phase 2 · ADVM-022 in diabetic macular edema · not yet approved

evidence.summary: announced a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) of hypotony (clinically-relevant decrease in ocular pressure) in its INFINITY clinical trial evaluating ADVM-022 gene therapy for the treatment of diabetic macular edema (DME)
evidence.safety: one patient treated with a single intravitreal injection of the high dose (6 x 10^11 vg/eye) of ADVM-022 who has developed hypotony, with panuveitis and loss of vision in the treated eye
